fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-10-27, around 16:10, a group of persons allegedly attacked the complainant at Senthil Garden Main Street, causing injuries that required treatment, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-10-28. The online submission was made by Praveen Raman (9000000201). Karthik Balan (mobile 9000000380) was named as a possible person of interest. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute.
